name: AppLovin CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: AppLovin Corporation builds and runs a mobile marketing platform whose products include AppDiscovery, MAX, Adjust and SparkLabs. The software helps mobile app developers market and monetize their apps. Andrew Karam, John Krystynak and Adam Foroughi founded the company in 2011, and it is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
